name: MedievalGallantmon
main_effect:
[Security] Play this card without battling and without paying the cost. Return this Digimon to your hand at the end of the turn.
[On Play] [When Attacking] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 6000 DP or less. If no Digimon was deleted by this effect, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon, and that Digimon doesn't unsuspend during their next unsuspend phase.
